text: 你反对卖淫合法化并无不可，只是你自己也没有什么论据，单纯因为你对嫖娼行为感到鄙视，认为道德有失。
en: It is perfectly fine for you to oppose the legalisation of prostitution; it is just that you yourself have no real arguments, merely feeling disdain for the act of soliciting prostitutes and believing it to be a moral failing.

text: 社会反对卖淫一个核心点是性可以成为被剥削的价值，如果不加以制止，这将会对许多底层人群的人权造成压迫。
en: A core point in society's opposition to prostitution is that sex can become an exploited value, and if left unchecked this will oppress the human rights of many people at the bottom of society.

text: 现在的问题却在于没有抑制社会出现卖淫的妥善办法，权贵们依旧掌控着庞大的性资源，而底层人群却没法合法合理获取性释放，反映出极为不平衡的利益分配问题。
en: The problem now, however, is that there is no proper way to suppress the emergence of prostitution in society. The powerful still control vast sexual resources, while those at the bottom have no lawful or reasonable means to obtain sexual release, which reflects an extremely unbalanced distribution of interests.

text: 你说你鄙视去嫖娼的人，还与强奸同罪。
en: You say that you disdain those who solicit prostitutes, equating it with the crime of rape.

text: 问题就来了，社会各领域都有着不同形式的性压迫，那本身就属于隐性卖淫，对这些现象视若无睹的才是道德观扭曲。
en: Here is the problem: every sphere of society contains different forms of sexual oppression, which in themselves constitute covert prostitution; those who turn a blind eye to such phenomena are the ones with a distorted sense of morality.

text: 都不需要提什么富哥们开高端局，带一群美女出去旅游是合理合法。
en: One need not even mention how wealthy men throw lavish parties and take a group of beautiful women on trips as something perfectly reasonable and legal.

text: 名媛通过龟公牵线去跟企业大佬睡觉，一旦曝光也就是自由恋爱。
en: Socialites are introduced by pimps to sleep with business tycoons, and once exposed it is simply called free love.

text: 富商包养十几个女学生放在自己豪宅，在自家行乐也理所当然。
en: Wealthy merchants keep a dozen or so female students in their mansions, and enjoying themselves at home is taken for granted.

text: 比方说制片人、导演潜规则女演员，算不算性交换？
en: For example, when a producer or director sleeps with an actress under the unspoken rule, does that count as a sexual exchange?

text: 导师示意女学生陪睡，算不算性交换？
en: When a supervisor implies that a female student must sleep with him, does that count as a sexual exchange?

text: 做销售的为了达成交易陪客人睡觉，算不算性交换？
en: When a salesperson sleeps with clients to close a deal, does that count as a sexual exchange?

text: COS以陪睡方式让摄影师帮修图，算不算利益交换？
en: When a cosplayer gets a photographer to retouch photos in exchange for sleeping with him, does that count as an exchange of interests?

text: 榜一大哥打了几万块，约女主播出来吃饭，顺便打一炮，算不算性交换？
en: When a top-tipping big brother spends tens of thousands of yuan, invites a female streamer out for a meal, and by the way has a quick shag, does that count as a sexual exchange?

text: 更别提海王们送台手机玩遍女学生的套路，送手机怎么能算嫖资呢？
en: Not to mention the players' trick of gifting a phone to sleep with every female student — how could a gifted phone count as payment for prostitution?

text: 这些如何不是剥削形象，处于高层之人通过威逼利诱，终能获取性利益。
en: How are these not images of exploitation? Those in high positions, through coercion and enticement, ultimately obtain sexual benefit.

text: 如果你鄙视卖淫，认为这不仅是道德问题，还是严重的犯罪，那么你想办法从根本上抑制社会上各式各样的隐性卖淫。
en: If you disdain prostitution and believe it is not only a moral issue but also a serious crime, then you should find a way to fundamentally suppress the various forms of covert prostitution in society.

text: 隐性卖淫普遍到在旧社会中，属于隔壁老王过来帮忙修个什么东西，都可以用性作为回报，可不是什么稀罕物。
en: Covert prostitution was so widespread in old society that when the neighbour next door came over to help fix something, sex could be offered as repayment — it was no rare thing.

text: 我依稀记得国内早年还出过一个少女反向剥削老头的情况，最开始是老头给点零花钱利诱少女行苟且，后来少女习惯了没钱就去找老头，可老头年纪大了体力不支，对少女的侵扰苦不堪言，最终东窗事发。
en: I vaguely recall that in this country years ago there was even a case of a young girl exploiting an old man in reverse. At first the old man enticed the girl with pocket money to engage in illicit relations; later the girl grew accustomed to going to the old man whenever she was short of money. But the old man, advanced in age and lacking the stamina, suffered unbearably from the girl's molestation, and in the end the matter came to light.

text: 就因为不是明码标价，隐藏在社会规则里就被视作理所当然，指不定有许多做过隐性卖淫之人，还在狠狠痛骂卖淫者，无非就是个掩耳盗铃。
en: Simply because it is not openly priced and is hidden within social rules, it is regarded as a matter of course. It is quite possible that many who have engaged in covert prostitution are still fiercely condemning prostitutes — nothing more than a case of deceiving oneself.

text: 哦，你做销售陪客人睡觉就行，人家开按摩店顺便增加点服务就不行，这合理吗？
en: Oh, you can sleep with clients as a salesperson, but a person running a massage parlour who incidentally offers a few extra services cannot — is that reasonable?

text: 如果性交易换一个名头就能够合理进行，有更多的权势就能合法化，你不觉得现今社会上过分默许卖淫行为了吗？
en: If a sex transaction can proceed legitimately under a different name, and greater power can legalise it, do you not think that society today tolerates prostitution far too much?

text: 不觉得权贵与有性需求的平民的权益差异太大了吗？
en: Do you not feel that the gap in rights and interests between the powerful and ordinary people with sexual needs is far too great?

text: 所以无论是支持合法化亦或是坚持打击，终究都是个行政管理的问题，去平衡社会的结构。
en: So whether one supports legalisation or insists on suppression, it ultimately comes down to a matter of administrative management, to balance the structure of society.

text: 所以我认为成龙说的很对，中国人是要管的，不管会天下大乱。
en: So I think Jackie Chan was quite right: the Chinese people need to be governed; if left ungoverned, there will be great disorder under heaven.

text: 持这种论调的人，我已经不去反驳了
en: I have stopped arguing with people who hold such views.

text: 当知乎上都已经出现支持幼儿的性同意权这种人的时候，你还顾得上反驳成年人卖淫的事情吗？
en: When there are already people on Zhihu supporting the sexual consent rights of young children, do you still have the leisure to argue about adult prostitution?

text: 注意，是幼儿的性同意权哦，是那些只有五六七八岁的幼儿哦，那个男人的论调是，即使他30岁胡子拉碴看起来长的根块水里泡了十年的朽木一样，只要他问小女孩是否同意和他发生性关系，小女孩没有摇头反驳，就是同意哦，要尊重人权哦。
en: Note, it is the sexual consent rights of young children — those only five, six, seven or eight years old. That man's argument is that even if he is thirty, unshaven, and looks like a rotten log that has been soaking in water for ten years, as long as he asks a little girl whether she agrees to have sex with him, and the little girl does not shake her head to object, that counts as consent — one must respect human rights, you see.

text: 当这种人出现在知乎这种平台的时候，其他平台估计和蟑螂窝差不多了。
en: When such people appear on a platform like Zhihu, the other platforms are probably not much different from a cockroach nest.

text: 本来我最后想告诉他，他也会有孩子，无论男孩女孩，都会面临如朽木一样的其他男人的时候，忽然语塞了。
en: Originally I wanted to tell him in the end that he too will have children, and whether a son or daughter, they will face other men like rotten logs — but I suddenly fell speechless.

text: 因为我意识到，他的孩子遇到的第一危险就是如死水泡了10年的朽木一样的男人，这个号称他父亲的男人。
en: Because I realised that the first danger his child will encounter is a man like a rotten log soaked in stagnant water for ten years — the man who claims to be his father.

text: 所以，这种人都出现了，成年人卖淫还有什么可稀奇的？
en: So, now that such people have appeared, what is there to find strange about adult prostitution?

text: 很多人没有做韦小宝的命，但并不排除他们想有一个韦春花的妈，我支持祝福他们梦想成真，有一个这样的妈妈。
en: Many people are not fated to be Wei Xiaobao, but that does not rule out their wishing to have a Wei Chunhua for a mother. I support and bless them in realising this dream, of having such a mother.

text: 卖淫合法不可行的理由只有一条，也只需要一条：
en: The only reason prostitution cannot be legalised — and the only one needed — is:

text: 很多人会“被自愿”。
en: Many people will be 'willing against their will'.

text: 你说再多理论，论证各种自由，只要这个问题解决不了，一切都是空中楼阁，改变不了压迫的本质。
en: No matter how much theory you expound or how many kinds of freedom you argue for, so long as this problem remains unsolved, everything is a castle in the air and cannot change the essence of oppression.

text: 大部分人连上班都是被自愿的，竟然觉得在纯粹的自由市场里，存在绝对的自由意志？
en: Most people are 'willing' even to go to work against their will — and yet they believe that in a pure free market, absolute free will exists?

text: 看看隔壁日本吧，AV女优就相当于合法的鸡。
en: Look at neighbouring Japan: an AV actress is essentially a legal prostitute.

text: 女优中固然有不少自愿入行的存在，但还有很多，是被“星探”用“拍电影”欺骗签下了奇怪的合同，还有一些是欠了雅库扎的钱，大哥们一边灌水泥桶一边问你要不要自愿去拍片还债。
en: Among AV actresses there are certainly quite a few who entered the trade voluntarily, but many others were deceived by 'talent scouts' promising 'film roles' into signing strange contracts, and some owe money to the yakuza — the bosses, while pouring cement into drums, ask whether you would like to voluntarily go and shoot films to repay your debt.

text: 只要你不能确定每一个人都是发自内心的真自愿，这事情就没得商量。
en: So long as you cannot be certain that every single person is truly and sincerely willing from the heart, there is no room for negotiation on this matter.

text: 说实话，我觉得这么基础的东西还需要我来说，上面还有那么多离谱的高赞，这个世界的崩溃速度确实超过了我的预期
en: To be honest, I find it absurd that such basic things still need me to explain them, and on top of that there are so many absurd highly upvoted answers. The rate at which this world is collapsing has truly exceeded my expectations.

text: 未经批准的快乐都是有害的，因此需要禁止
en: Unauthorised happiness is harmful, and therefore must be prohibited.

text: 你问对什么有害？
en: You ask, harmful to what?

text: 对老爷的权威有害
en: Harmful to the authority of the masters.

text: 每次一到这种问题就有人提你老婆女儿如何如何的，你们对社会学老婆和生物学女儿有什么意见吗？
en: Every time such a question comes up, someone brings up your wife and daughter and so on — do you have some objection to sociological wives and biological daughters?

text: 我想问，卖淫和在流水线当牛马，有什么区别？
en: I want to ask: what is the difference between prostitution and being a beast of burden on the assembly line?

text: 论收入，没有卖淫挣得多，论尊严？
en: In terms of income, one does not earn as much as in prostitution; and in terms of dignity?

text: 牛马也不比鸡更有尊严。
en: Beasts of burden are no more dignified than prostitutes.

text: 唯一好处就是流水线当牛马是“合法”的，而这个“合法”也并不是真正的合法，只是执法部门不管你们而已
en: The only benefit is that being a beast of burden on the assembly line is 'legal', but this 'legal' is not truly legal either — it is merely that the law enforcement authorities turn a blind eye to you.

text: 卖淫合法化，如果你失业，申请失业保险，
en: With the legalisation of prostitution, if you become unemployed and apply for unemployment insurance,

text: 相关人员会推荐你去当鸡，这是法律规定的
en: the relevant personnel will recommend that you become a prostitute — this is what the law stipulates.

text: 合法职业。
en: A legal occupation.

text: 德国干过这事。
en: Germany has done this.

text: 2013外媒明镜周刊spiegel报道了一件事。
en: In 2013, the foreign media outlet Der Spiegel reported an incident.

text: 新闻阐明，一家具有“德国政府背景的就业推荐中心”，发出道歉。
en: The news stated that an 'employment referral centre with a German government background' issued an apology.

text: 为他们“再一次”推荐去女孩去红灯区就业事件道歉。
en: for 'once again' recommending that girls go to the red-light district for employment.

text: 介绍所声称这只是“又一次的工作疏忽”
en: The agency claimed this was merely 'yet another work oversight'.

text: 女孩19岁，来自奥格斯堡，德国南部城市，找工作找了几个月，直到政府背景的职业介绍所，联系她，推荐她去红灯区当侍女
en: The girl was 19, from Augsburg, a city in southern Germany. She had been looking for work for several months until a government-backed employment agency contacted her and recommended that she go to the red-light district to work as a hostess.

text: 本次事件，红灯区娱乐场所名为“斗兽场”。
en: In this incident, the red-light entertainment venue was named 'the Colosseum'.

text: 职业是侍女，负责提供酒水，要求是女孩，年轻，貌美。
en: The job was hostess, responsible for serving drinks; the requirements were that she be a girl, young and beautiful.

text: 工作时间每周42小时，在晚上，与周末。
en: Working hours were 42 hours per week, in the evenings and on weekends.

text: 斗兽场营业面积2500平米，有女孩提供各种色情服务，也有水吧，酒吧。
en: The Colosseum had a business area of 2,500 square metres, with girls providing various sexual services, as well as a juice bar and a pub.

text: 女孩父母知晓后非常生气，职业所道歉。
en: After the girl's parents found out they were very angry, and the employment agency apologised.

text: 以上为原文大意。
en: The above is the gist of the original text.

en: two years later,

en: in 2004 Berlin, Germany enacted a law stipulating that relevant institutions may not cut the benefits of the unemployed — such as unemployment insurance — because they refuse to become sex workers.
